name: gas_engine_identified_nominal_point
title: Identified full-load point of a 5 L four-stroke gas engine
summary: Steady-state model of the natural-gas engine of the ULiège MSTh course at its maximum-power point (2400 rpm), recomputed from the engine characteristics identified in exercise 1 (valve area, jacket and water-to-environment conductance products, indicated efficiency, friction torque): carburettor, intake pressure drop through the valve, adiabatic combustion with the cpbar mean specific heat, expansion, jacket (eps-NTU) and ambient losses; shaft power and fuel flow are outputs (exercise 2, second part).
language_features: user-library routine cpbar (implicit library, copied; function-position calls in the native file, CALL form in the variant)

authors: ULiège MSTh course (J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio)
origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), repetition TP 08, exercise 2 (SB solution)

verification.summary: Variant checked (native file blocked, CS-GAP-INCLUDE): the 31 variables of the EES stored solution of TM-0133 agree at rtol=0.001; vs the full stored solution of TM-0132 (same engine point) 72 common variables, 11 differ - the air entropy reference offset, 9.4e-3 on cp_f (ideal-gas vs CoolProp) and 2.6e-3 max from the rounded identified inputs. Nominal data reproduced: 90 kW, 22 kg/h, 90 kW, 8 kW.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of TM-0133 (31 of 76 variables) and full stored solution of TM-0132 'MSTh - R8 - Ex 1 SB.EES' (72 of 74, same engine point with the measured inputs), compared with tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: compare_solution.py vs TM-0132 prints '72 common variables, 11 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 18'. The largest is s_2 (3.19e-01, a constant EES-vs-CoolProp entropy reference offset of 1814.9 J/kg-K); the next, cp_f 9.41e-03 and Q_dot_2 9.09e-03, are the ideal-gas CH4 vs CoolProp heat capacity (same deviation as CSL-0034/CSL-0149); the remaining 8 (2.3e-3 to 2.6e-3) are the rounding of the identified characteristics passed as inputs (AU_gw 83.8 vs 83.7955, A_f_soupapes 0.002072 vs 0.002072256, W_dot_m = 2*pi*N*T_m 10000.3 W vs the 10 kW imposed in Ex 1). vs TM-0133: '31 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 59'.
